description: Reground for the upcoming holidays with Himalayan bowls and other traditional healing instruments
long_description:
Reground for the upcoming holidays with Himalayan bowls and other traditional healing instruments

About this Event

Join me for a free public sound bath to reground and relax before the upcoming holidays. Settle in with the sounds of Himalayan bowls and a few other traditional healing instruments, played at a comfortable, relaxing volume. Soft floor lighting will be used so the overhead lights can be turned off and the room can feel a little more restful.
Everyone is welcome. Come in, find a comfortable place, and stay for all or any part of the session. Bring what you need to be comfortable. Chairs will also be available.
Where: Washburn Library, 5244 Lyndale Avenue South Minneapolis, MN, 55419 (downstairs meeting room, elevator accessible)
When: Saturday, 11/21/2026, 1:15 - 2:15 pm
This is a free community event
